gate_1_payer_alone.claim: the switch scan's first payer, alone and cold, at da8d1679 (before #283 and #284), b1de6f7c (#283) and 3cb468c4 (#284): #283 leaves it as it was, and #284's run-constant traces add a little
gate_1_payer_alone.case: tests/saved/test_switch_scan.py::test_the_tree_passes_the_scan_with_its_list_and_its_owners, alone and cold, three arms, each the three commits once in a rotated order
